node: Marine biofouling, hull coatings, cleaning and vessel-efficiency compliance
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the speculative second-order lane around marine biofouling, antifouling coatings, hull cleaning/inspection, and vessel-efficiency compliance. The cleanest direct US-listed exposure found is not a pure-play small cap; it is split between large diversified coatings companies with marine antifouling products and smaller/micro-cap marine robotics or subsea inspection companies whose commercial-shipping relevance still needs proof. RPM is the most interesting underfollowed large/mid-ish mapping because its Pettit and Carboline brands explicitly touch antifouling and commercial marine coatings, while OPTT is a high-risk micro-cap exception because of a specific autonomous hull-grooming collaboration. No buy/sell recommendation is implied.
